W.note: Restrained outline-icon cards with labeled variant chips and real add, error and sold-out states, but no cart view and the mobile layout leaves one narrow column with wasted width.

X.note: A complete storefront with search, filters, sort, stock badges and a persistent cart drawer with totals, though it reads more like a full shop than a minimal component and uses emoji for product art.

Y.note: Good in-grid quantity steppers and a cart drawer, but there is no sold-out or stock state, hover lift adds decoration, and on mobile the Cart button is stranded on its own line under the search.

Z.note: The most disciplined build: per-variant sold-out chips with explicit reasons, aria-disabled add with spinner, added and error states, labeled fieldsets, and a clean mobile stack, though the cart is only a text summary and the three-card desktop leaves much empty space.
